metadata.name: Laboratory experiment of zooplankton treatments – X. umbellata pulsation measurements
metadata.description: The dataset contains 60 complete records from a laboratory experiment. Each record includes the constant study type "Laboratory experiment", a tank identifier (12 distinct tanks), a treatment type (4 distinct treatments), a DOE value ranging from 0 to 28 (mean 14), and X. umbellata pulsation measurements ranging from 22 to 41.33 (mean 33.91). No temporal or geographic information is provided.
